name: amplifi-quotes
description: Quoting for service businesses, on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry && node scripts/check-bundle.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run test:e2e

SETUP_CODE.description: A code you make up (12+ characters). You'll type it on first visit to claim the owner account. Keep it somewhere safe.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Optional. A [Resend](https://resend.com) API key so the app can send email. Leave blank to send quotes from your own email app.

SMTP2GO_API_KEY.description: Optional. An [SMTP2GO](https://www.smtp2go.com) API key, as an alternative to Resend.

INTEGRATION_KEY.description: Optional. A random string used to encrypt integration secrets. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`.
